_comments.default: Without -P the installer removes every model: line, so subagents inherit the model you chose in pi (/model or settings). This is the recommended mode when you change models often: switching the parent model needs no reinstall. Use -P to pin a different model per tier.
_comments.tiers: Tiers are roles: opus = planning and review, sonnet = implementation (worker agent), haiku = exploration (scout agent). An agent file marks its role with model: opus|sonnet|haiku; install replaces that marker with the profile's ID.
_comments.ids: Every ID must be the exact provider/model-id string. pi fuzzy-matches --model patterns across all providers it considers available, so a partial name such as opus can silently resolve to an unintended and expensive provider.
_comments.prices: Prices and quotas are not tracked here; check the provider before pinning a model.
_comments.unmapped: A tier missing from a profile, or an agent whose model: is not one of the three tiers, has its model line removed (the agent inherits the parent model) and install prints a WARN.
_comments.add-a-profile: Add a key under profiles with opus, sonnet, and haiku IDs, then install with -P <name> (pass the same -P to uninstall.sh). Re-run with -f to refresh agents already installed.
